# Version 4.151.0
> **Performance and Skia m151** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates the bundled engine to Skia m151 and delivers a significant managed-layer performance pass. Hot paths across color conversion, SKColor hex parsing, HarfBuzzSharp UTF-8 buffering and SKShaper glyph reading shed allocations and P/Invoke round-trips. WASM gets .NET 11 / Emscripten 5.0.6 support, and a CPU raster regression introduced in the preview line is corrected.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m151** — The bundled engine advances to Chrome milestone 151, with multiple upstream chrome/m151 bug-fix merges folded in throughout the preview cycle. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489))
- **CPU raster regression corrected** — Restores SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT, which was accidentally dropped in an upstream sync and caused a CPU raster rendering regression. ([#4428](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4428))

## API Surface

- **SKColor hex parsing with ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads** — The hex-color parser is rewritten to parse directly from a span, avoiding intermediate string allocations, and new `ReadOnlySpan<char>` overloads are added. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData with crop rect** — The `SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI)` overload now releases the encoded data handle when decoding fails, closing a native resource leak. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Managed-layer performance pass** — SKColor-to-SKColorF and SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply are ported to integer math in managed C#, eliminating P/Invoke round-trips. SKShaper reads glyph results via zero-copy spans. HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8 becomes allocation-free using a pooled UTF-8 encoder, and per-call char[4] allocations in HBTag.Parse and SKFourByteTag.Parse are eliminated. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385), [#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388), [#4376](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4376), [#4408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4408), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396))

## Platform

- **WebAssembly support for .NET 11 / Emscripten 5.0.6** — Adds Emscripten 5.0.6 static library slices (with new exnref exception handling) and a preview-.NET WASM test job so exception-handling regressions are caught early. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4487](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4487), [#4488](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4488))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Carries HarfBuzz 14.2.1 with allocation-free UTF-8 buffering in Buffer.AddUtf8 and eliminated per-call allocations in HBTag.Parse.

## Release Candidate 1 (July 21, 2026)

The release candidate landed the CPU raster regression fix (SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT), the native resource leak fix in SKImage.FromEncodedData, the preview-.NET WASM test job, and additional upstream m151 stability fixes.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.151.0-preview.2.1...v4.151.0-rc.1.1)

## Preview 2 (July 14, 2026)

Preview 2 delivered the bulk of the performance pass — managed SKColor/SKPMColor math, SKShaper zero-copy spans, allocation-free HarfBuzzSharp UTF-8 buffering, and the SKColor hex parsing overhaul — plus the Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM slices and upstream chrome/m151 bug-fix merges.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.151.0-preview.1.1...v4.151.0-preview.2.1)

## Preview 1 (July 2, 2026)

Preview 1 opened the 4.151 line with the Skia m151 engine update and the WebAssembly build cleanup.
